description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance across various Fine-tuning Methods. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Fine-tuning Method," and displays seven methods in the following order: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, $S_1$-model, $S_4$-model, and $S_5$-model. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "GLUE Performance," using a linear scale with numeric tick labels at 86 and 88, indicating an interval of 2, and a visible range extending from approximately 84 to just above 89. The chart features grouped vertical bars, with two bars per category representing different model sizes as indicated by the legend titled "RoBERTa Size." Within each group, the left bar represents the "base" size, colored in dark blue-grey, and the right bar represents the "large" size, colored in brown. The approximate values for the "base" model bars are 84.6 for Prefix, 84.4 for Adaptor, 86.6 for LoRA, 84.3 for BitFit (the shortest bar overall), 85.6 for $S_1$-model, 86.2 for $S_4$-model, and 87.0 for $S_5$-model. The approximate values for the "large" model bars are 85.7 for Prefix, 88.1 for Adaptor, 88.9 for LoRA, 87.7 for BitFit, 85.6 for $S_1$-model, 87.6 for $S_4$-model, and 89.2 for $S_5$-model (the tallest bar overall). The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order based on their values, and there are no visually emphasized bars.
